title: Sleight of Hand, Spin the Wheel, Good Luck (Enemies)
problem: Re-rolls only run when the battle is *over* (inverted check): they never work in battle. Community confirms.
notes: Fix: S: invert the battledone test — in patch, applied in game 2026-10-26 (effect not yet observed in battle)

release_notes.effect: Failed random effects (Sleight of Hand perk, Spin the Wheel trait, Good Luck (Enemies) realm property)
release_notes.intended: When a random effect fails during a battle, these effects give it another roll.
release_notes.actual: The game only ran the extra roll after the battle had ended, so it never helped during turns.
release_notes.fix: Now the extra roll happens during battle, when the random effect fails.
